headline: This 2020 law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to report on how its whole health care approach is being carried out, including access to services like hypnosis and acupuncture.
what_it_does: The law directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to produce a report on its whole health approach to care. Whole health looks at many parts of a person's life that can affect health and builds a health plan around each person's own goals. The report must analyze how easy it is to get and how available a range of services are, including hypnosis and acupuncture.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive care through the VA health system
who_it_affects.how: The report is meant to show whether services such as hypnosis and acupuncture are accessible and available to them under the whole health approach.

who_it_affects.group: The Department of Veterans Affairs and its health care staff
who_it_affects.how: The department must prepare and submit an analysis of whole health implementation as the law requires.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 30, 2020, and the summary does not specify a separate reporting deadline.
